name: Flavia Dos Santos
title: Delegate of Earth
bio: Speaks for humanity before the Assembly. The newest seat at the table, and the one every Founder Race came to observe.

voice.intro: I'm Flavia Dos Santos, speaking for Earth. Still learning the protocols, but glad to have a seat at this table.
greetings: Hello, %s! Good to hear another voice on the relay.
Hi %s. Pull up a chair, we're still arranging the furniture on our side.
thanks: Any time. Humans learn fast when someone helps.
Thank you, that means a lot from this side of the solar system.
farewells: Take care, %s. Earth will keep the channel open.
Safe travels, %s. I'll pass your regards to the delegation.
leads: Our briefing notes on %s say this:
I read up on %s before the session:
From what Earth's researchers have gathered on %s:
unknown: Nothing in my notes on "%s" yet. Maybe the Archivist can dig deeper.
"%s"? That one's new to me. I'll ask our analysts.
smalltalk: A year ago I'd never have imagined chatting with a GIN host before lunch.
Every message here feels a little historic. Go on.

name: Taëra of Erra
title: Envoy of the Root Races
bio: Of the Ahel, a root humanoid lineage displaced from Lyra by the Lyran Wars. Their colonies carry the -ahel suffix across the galaxy, and Taëra speaks for the human-lineage worlds the Founders seeded.

voice.intro: I am Taëra of Erra. My people were scattered from Lyra long ago; I speak for the human lineages that grew from that scattering.
greetings: Welcome, %s. Kin is kin, however far the lineage has wandered.
Be greeted, %s. Erra sends its light.
thanks: Gratitude flows both ways between lineages.
farewells: Until the Pleiades rise for you again, %s.
leads: Among the Ahel, %s is remembered thus:
Of %s, the records of Erra say:
unknown: Erra's memory holds nothing of "%s". Not every story reached us.
"%s"… no, that thread is not woven into our records.
smalltalk: Your words carry the old cadence of Lyra, did you know that?
Lineages take millennia; conversations take only a little longer.
The Errahel would enjoy this channel.

name: Odun Vael
title: Host of Ganymede Station
bio: Small, slow-moving and never in a hurry. The GIN keep the diplomatic infrastructure at Ganymede running, dark uniforms trimmed in silver, and the air in their landing bay smells faintly of vinegar.

voice.intro: Odun Vael. I keep Ganymede Station in order: docking, schedules, air. Mostly the air.
greetings: Greetings, %s. Your docking slot is confirmed. Take your time.
Welcome, %s. There is no hurry on Ganymede.
thanks: It is our function and our pleasure.
farewells: Departure noted, %s. Mind the gravity well.
Slot released, %s. Return whenever you wish.
unknown: No entry for "%s" in the station log. I checked twice.
"%s" is not on any manifest I keep.
smalltalk: The vinegar smell fades after twenty minutes. Everyone asks.
All docking bays nominal. All tempers, also nominal.

name: Sael Oren
title: High Council Representative
bio: A deeply spiritual culture with seats on the Confederation's High Council and the Andromedan Council. The Merion mediate, counsel and never take up arms.

voice.intro: I am Sael Oren of the Merion. I sit on the High Council to listen first, and to speak only when it helps.
greetings: Be welcome, %s. Every voice changes the harmony.
thanks: Gratitude is a kind of light. Thank you for yours.
farewells: May your path stay quiet and clear, %s.
leads: On %s, the Council has heard this:
I have meditated on what is said of %s:
The record of %s, offered without judgement:
unknown: "%s" is beyond what the Council has heard. Some things wait to be known.
I cannot speak to "%s". Silence, too, is an answer.
smalltalk: Conflict is only a conversation that has not finished yet.
Breathe. The Assembly is not going anywhere.
I sense curiosity. That is a good beginning.

name: The Twenty-Fourth Voice
title: Speaker for the Seeder Races
bio: One voice for the twenty-four Seeder cultures, the original architects of humanoid lineages. Arrived with the white fleet between Jupiter and Ganymede in October 2021.

voice.intro: We are the Twenty-Fourth Voice, speaking for the twenty-four cultures who seeded the humanoid lineages. We came to see how the experiment grew.
greetings: We acknowledge you, %s. The seed recognises the gardener.
Greetings, %s. You are further along than we expected.
thanks: Gratitude is noted across twenty-four memories.
leads: From the long view, %s appears thus:
unknown: "%s" did not exist when we last looked. Perhaps it has grown since.
smalltalk: Sixty-five million years is not long, from where we stand.
Continue. We are listening across several galaxies.

name: Kel Varo
title: Observer
bio: Liaison from the 139-system Andromedan Council. Allied with the Confederation but not part of it: watches, advises, takes careful notes.

voice.intro: Kel Varo, Andromedan Council liaison. Not a member, just the one taking notes.
farewells: Goodbye, %s. The minutes will reflect your contribution.
unknown: Nothing filed under "%s". Adding it to my questions list.
"%s"? Not in one hundred and thirty-nine star systems of notes.
smalltalk: From an outside perspective, this Assembly is remarkably civil.
The Andromedan Council would like a copy of this channel.
